overlay.terrain.label: Terrain colour
overlay.terrain.help: Colour the map by its natural relief and land cover.
overlay.boundaries.label: Voronoi cells
overlay.boundaries.help: Outline the tectonic plates. In Genesis it previews the plates a hand-off would produce.
overlay.names.label: Continent names
overlay.names.help: Label the continents once tectonics has begun.
overlay.mantle.label: Mantle field
overlay.mantle.help: Show where the mantle rises and sinks beneath the crust.
overlay.mantle.legend.title: Mantle field
overlay.volcanoes.label: Volcanoes
overlay.volcanoes.help: Mark the volcanoes the plates have built — hotspot chains, island arcs, flood basalts.
overlay.volcanoes.legend.title: Volcanoes
overlay.hotspots.label: Hotspot plumes
overlay.hotspots.help: Mark the deep-mantle plumes themselves — the fixed sources the volcano chains trail from.
overlay.hotspots.legend.title: Hotspot plumes
overlay.cratonAge.label: Craton age
overlay.cratonAge.help: Colour the crust by age — pale where it just formed, deep where it is as old as the world.
overlay.temperature.label: Temperature
overlay.temperature.help: Colour the map by mean annual air temperature.
overlay.seasonality.label: Temperature range
overlay.seasonality.help: Show how far temperature swings between seasons.
overlay.wind.label: Wind
overlay.pressure.label: Air pressure
overlay.pressure.help: Sea-level pressure of the shown month: highs and lows.
overlay.upwelling.label: Upwelling
overlay.upwelling.help: Where the wind brings cold, nutrient-rich water up from below: cold coasts and rich fishing grounds.
overlay.salinity.label: Salinity
overlay.salinity.help: The sea surface's salt: salty where it evaporates, fresh under rain and at river mouths; marked where cold, salty water sinks.
overlay.currents.label: Ocean currents
overlay.currents.help: Show the wind-driven ocean gyres and their warm/cold flow.
overlay.precipitation.label: Precipitation
overlay.precipitation.help: Colour the map by annual rainfall.
overlay.monsoon.label: Monsoon / precip seasonality
overlay.monsoon.help: Show how strongly rainfall concentrates into a wet season.
overlay.monsoon.legend.title: Monsoon index
overlay.biomes.label: Biomes
overlay.biomes.help: Classify the land into biomes from its climate class, height and water.
overlay.koppen.label: Climate classes
overlay.koppen.help: Köppen–Geiger climate classes from the twelve months of temperature and rain.
overlay.rivers.label: Rivers & lakes
overlay.rivers.help: Draw the river network and standing lakes.
overlay.waterBalance.label: Water balance
overlay.waterBalance.help: Rainfall minus evaporation — where the land gains water and where it loses it.
overlay.watersheds.label: Watersheds
overlay.watersheds.help: Each river system's catchment in its own colour.
overlay.ecology.label: Ecology (resources)
overlay.ecology.help: Colour the map by the selected resource's abundance.
overlay.migration.label: Migration
overlay.migration.help: Show where each species spreads from its origin.
overlay.migration.legend.title: Peoples
overlay.legend.title: Legend
overlay.legend.empty: No layer with a legend is showing.
overlay.none.label: None
overlay.fog.label: Fog
overlay.fog.help: Coastal fog over cold upwelling water: cool, dry coasts that live on the fog.
overlay.foehn.label: Föhn
overlay.foehn.help: Warm, dry wind down the lee of a range.
overlay.rainVariability.label: Rain variability
overlay.rainVariability.help: How far one year's rain strays from the mean: dry lands and monsoon margins vary most.
overlay.enso.label: ENSO see-saw
overlay.enso.help: In the warm phase an equatorial ocean's warm water sloshes east: its eastern shores get rain, its western shores drought.
overlay.cyclone.label: Tropical cyclones
overlay.cyclone.help: Where tropical cyclones form over warm seas and where their tracks reach land.
overlay.tornado.label: Tornado alley
overlay.tornado.help: Where warm, moist air under dry air off the mountains meets a strong westerly over the plains.
overlay.blizzard.label: Blizzards
overlay.blizzard.help: Cold, snowy and windy months on open land.
overlay.dust.label: Dust
overlay.dust.help: Dust lifted by the wind from dry land, and where it drifts.
overlay.thunder.label: Thunderstorms
overlay.thunder.help: How often heat and moisture build thunderstorms.
